description: This file defines a React component named OutputDataPanel, which displays the output data of a workflow execution, including options for viewing the data formatted or in JSON, and features like copying the output JSON and showing output size. It imports UI components, icons, and type definitions, and manages view modes with React state.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string with units B, KB, MB, GB.
